speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing this chronic cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this cough for over six months, and it definitely gets worse at night. It also makes it hard for me to keep up with my delivery route because I get short of breath when I start moving. However, i do not consent to any imaging or lab work. Please diagnose based solely on my reported symptoms and history.

speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your hesitation, but to ensure your safety on the delivery route, I need to know if you experience wheezing, chest tightness, or coughing up any mucus or blood. Additionally, do you have a history of allergies, asthma, or recent exposure to dust or chemicals? DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) or Asthma (pending symptom clarification).
